lines.native: Buongiorno. Sono Marginalia. Benvenuto nella mia libreria. I sell books only to people who understand them. No spoilers; there will be a small reading test.
lines.translation: Good morning. I'm Marginalia. Welcome to my bookshop. I sell books only to people who understand them. No spoilers; there will be a small reading test.
lines.narrative: Marginalia emerges from a hole in a book at The Old Bookshop. The hole is her review.

lines.native:

lines.translation:

lines.native: Non proprio. Journathan è il suo vero nome. Ma quale nome dà al Ciclope? Read the reply, not the name tag. Reading comprehension: still pending.
lines.translation: Not quite. Journathan is his real name. But what name does he give the Cyclops? Read the reply, not the name tag. Reading comprehension: still pending.

lines.native: Esatto! Ha detto «Nessuno». Hai capito: il libro è tuo. Reading comprehension: approved. Journathan va a casa, ma ricorda: it's about the journey, not the destination. Lui odia questa frase. No spoilers.
lines.translation: Exactly! He said “Nobody.” You understood: the book is yours. Reading comprehension: approved. Journathan goes home, but remember: it's about the journey, not the destination. He hates this sentence. No spoilers.
lines.narrative: Marginalia marks a small tick beside your name and slides the book across the counter. One corner has been eaten; apparently the introduction was unnecessary.
